p2_observations.title: Kiosk anonymous session redirect to /admin/pos when admin cookie present in same browser
p2_observations.severity: P2 (V1 scope OK — Le Cayenne LOCAL uses dedicated kiosk hardware tabs without admin sessions; multi-tenant SaaS V2 must isolate)
p2_observations.evidence: Browser with admin@lecayenne.fr session attempting /kiosk/idle silently redirects to /admin/pos. The kiosk JSON menu endpoint /api/frontend/menu correctly returns is_available=false for ruptured items.
p2_observations.v1_workaround: Use dedicated kiosk machine login (kiosk-lecayenne / KIOSK-LC-001) to access kiosk surface in production

verdict: GREEN — Rupture mid-commande handling is production-ready across all 4 cases and all 5 systems
summary: Coca-Cola 33cl rupture cycle tested across kiosk catalog/wizard, POS catalog/cart, KDS in-flight OOS badge, OSS public view, admin stock dashboard. Backend enforces at multiple points (Item.is_available + branch row lockForUpdate + 422 with FR message). Stale-quote-replay adversarial blocked. Race-condition concurrent toggle yields deterministic state. KDS has dedicated CV1-KDS-INFLIGHT-OOS-MARKER-001 feature for in-flight orders. No fund leak path identified.
